tldr: 台股週五狂飆 3,186.45 點、漲幅 7.98%，收 43,119.75 點，創史上最大單日漲點；台積電亮燈漲停 2,425 元，強勢收復 43,000 關卡。
三大法人終止連 3 賣、回補 846.76 億元；外資買超 675.54 億元（台積電 1.37 萬張）、投信買超 333.82 億元，全場 221 檔漲停。
反彈跟隨美股科技股勁揚，微軟財報優預期帶動費半漲 8%、台積電 ADR 揚逾 7%；瑞銀同步上修台灣 2026 GDP 成長率至 11%。
美股週五收高、7 月震盪封關，Amazon 財報亮眼跳漲 15%，那斯達克漲 1% 收 25,373.85 點；惟 30 年期美債殖利率飆至 2007 年來新高、逼近 5.25%。
國際油價飆漲，布蘭特原油突破每桶 88 美元、單月漲逾 20%，因美伊衝突再起及傳出油輪在荷莫茲海峽被迫折返。

items.title_zh: 台股飆史上最大漲點 3,186 點，台積電亮燈漲停
items.title_en: TAIEX rockets a record 3,186 points as TSMC locks limit-up
items.summary_zh: 加權指數週五上演史詩級反攻，終場大漲 3,186.45 點、漲幅 7.98%，收 43,119.75 點，創史上最大單日漲點，一舉扭轉本週稍早的重挫。台積電攻上漲停 2,425 元、漲 220 元，市值攀升至 62.88 兆元，單檔貢獻大盤約 1,746 點。盤面全面轉強，上漲 1,752 家、下跌僅 228 家，漲停多達 221 檔、跌停僅 2 檔，電子類指數大漲 9.19%，資金回流權值股態勢明確。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark staged a historic reversal on Friday, surging 3,186.45 points, or 7.98%, to close at 43,119.75 — the largest single-day point gain on record — after a brutal mid-week slide. TSMC hit limit-up at NT$2,425, up NT$220, lifting its market cap to NT$62.88tn and contributing about 1,746 index points. Breadth was overwhelming: 1,752 gainers against 228 decliners, with 221 stocks limit-up and just two limit-down, as the electronics sub-index jumped 9.19%.

items.title_zh: 三大法人回補 846.8 億，外資狂敲台積電
items.title_en: Three institutions swing to NT$84.7bn net buy, foreigners snap up TSMC
items.summary_zh: 歷經連續 3 個交易日賣超後，三大法人週五轉為合計買超 846.76 億元。外資及陸資買超 675.54 億元，其中近半金額重壓台積電、單日敲進 1.37 萬張；投信同步買超 333.82 億元，僅自營商續賣 162.59 億元。法人認為 8 月外資延續買超的可能性偏高，市場情緒由恐慌快速轉為回補，資金重新流入 AI 權值股，惟後續延續性仍待觀察，投資人宜留意漲多後的震盪風險。
items.summary_en: After three straight sessions of selling, the three major institutional investors flipped to a combined net buy of NT$84.68bn on Friday. Foreign and mainland investors bought a net NT$67.55bn — devoting nearly half of it to 13,700 lots of TSMC — while investment trusts added NT$33.38bn; only proprietary dealers stayed net sellers at NT$16.26bn. Analysts see a decent chance foreign buying extends into August, framing the reversal as sentiment swinging back from panic to re-accumulation.

items.title_zh: 成熟製程與封測股齊揚，AI 需求外溢供應鏈
items.title_en: Mature-node and packaging chipmakers surge as AI demand broadens
items.summary_zh: 週五漲勢不僅限於先進邏輯製程，資金強力回補成熟製程與後段封測族群。聯電、世界先進、力積電同步大漲，封測龍頭日月光投控、京元電子亦強勢走高，顯示晶片供應鏈在下半年終端需求穩健、AI 晶片先進封裝產能吃緊的支撐下，獲利預期獲大幅上修。此波漲勢廣度顯示市場重新評價整體半導體類股，而非僅集中於少數 AI 指標股，供應鏈題材延續性成為後市觀察重點。
items.summary_en: Friday's rally spread well beyond leading-edge logic, with strong capital rotation into mature-process and back-end names. UMC, Vanguard and Powerchip jumped alongside OSAT leaders ASE Technology and King Yuan Electronics, signalling that the chip supply chain is winning sharp earnings upgrades on resilient second-half end demand and tight AI-chip advanced-packaging capacity. The breadth of the move suggested investors were repricing the whole semiconductor complex rather than only the AI marquee names.

items.title_zh: AI 伺服器廠受惠雲端資本支出，瑞銀上修台灣 GDP 至 11%
items.title_en: AI server makers ride hyperscaler capex; UBS lifts Taiwan GDP to 11%
items.summary_zh: 隨北美超大規模雲端業者持續擴大第二季資本支出，台灣 AI 伺服器組裝與代工廠週五強勢跟漲，廣達、緯創、英業達同步走高，凸顯 AI 基礎建設需求持續傳導至島內製造業者。瑞銀進一步強化多頭氛圍，將台灣 2026 全年 GDP 成長率預估上修至 11%，主因設備進口與企業資本支出屢創新高，加上全球 AI 伺服器與高效能運算需求維持高檔，帶動出口與投資動能延續。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's AI server assemblers rallied hard on Friday as North American hyperscalers keep expanding second-quarter capital spending, lifting Quanta, Wistron and Inventec. The strength underscored how AI infrastructure demand continues to flow through to island manufacturers. UBS reinforced the bullish backdrop, raising its full-year 2026 Taiwan GDP growth forecast to 11%, citing record equipment imports and corporate capex plus sustained global demand for AI servers and high-performance computing.

items.title_zh: 金管會公布銀行內部評等法首批核准結果
items.title_en: FSC releases first-batch results for banks' internal-ratings-based capital approach
items.summary_zh: 金管會公布國銀採用內部評等法（IRB）計提信用風險資本的第一批核准結果。IRB 允許符合資格的銀行以自建風險模型取代標準化權數，通常可優化資本適足率、釋出放款與配息空間。此舉是台灣銀行業對接進階巴塞爾資本規範的又一進展，亦鼓勵銀行強化自身風險管理能力。獲准銀行資本運用彈性提升，有助支撐後續授信成長與股東回饋，對整體金融業體質為正向訊號，惟仍須符合主管機關持續監理要求。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission announced the first round of approval results for domestic banks applying the internal-ratings-based (IRB) approach to credit-risk capital calculation. The IRB framework lets qualifying banks use their own risk models rather than standardised weights, typically improving reported capital-adequacy ratios and freeing up room for lending and dividends. The move marks a further step in aligning Taiwan's banking sector with advanced Basel capital standards and rewarding stronger in-house risk management.

items.title_zh: 保險業上半年獲利逾 3,000 億，7 月動能恐降溫
items.title_en: Insurers post over NT$300bn first-half profit, but July momentum may cool
items.summary_zh: 台灣壽險與產險業 2026 上半年合計稅後淨利突破 3,000 億元，受惠投資收益與利率環境轉穩，繳出亮眼成績。然而分析師提醒，最甜蜜時刻恐已過去，7 月獲利可能因市場波動與避險成本上升而降溫。由於保險子公司在多家金控集團中占比甚高，保險業獲利走勢已成為評估金控整體獲利能力的關鍵指標，後續投資部位評價變動與新台幣匯率走勢，將是牽動下半年獲利表現的重要變數。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's life and non-life insurers booked more than NT$300bn in combined net profit for the first half of 2026, a bumper run powered by investment gains and a firmer rate backdrop. Analysts caution the "sweetest" stretch may be passing, warning that July results could soften as market volatility and hedging costs weigh. The sector's earnings trajectory has become a key gauge of financial-holding profitability given insurers' heavy weighting within Taiwan's major financial groups.

items.title_zh: 玉山 × KPMG 報告：高資產客群年複合成長約 10%
items.title_en: E.SUN–KPMG report: high-net-worth ranks to compound ~10% a year
items.summary_zh: 玉山銀行與 KPMG Taiwan 發布 2026 台灣高資產客戶財富管理與傳承調研報告指出，淨資產逾 1 億元的高資產族群，2025 至 2029 年年複合成長率上修至約 10%，高於 2021 至 2025 年的約 7%。境外資產配置幾成標配：億元級客群約 69% 已持有境外資產，十億等級超高資產族更達 86%。調研顯示跨境資產配置、信託與家族傳承服務需求持續攀升，銀行財管與私銀業務成長動能可期，惟須留意國際稅務與法遵合規要求。
items.summary_en: A 2026 wealth-and-succession survey by E.SUN Bank and KPMG Taiwan finds Taiwan's high-net-worth population (net worth above NT$100mn) growing at roughly a 10% compound annual rate through 2029, up from about 7% in 2021–2025. Offshore allocation is now near-standard: about 69% of NT$100mn-plus clients already hold overseas assets, rising to 86% among the ultra-wealthy above NT$1bn. The findings point to swelling demand for cross-border planning, trusts and family-succession services.

items.title_zh: 法規鬆綁持續擴大高資產商品版圖
items.title_en: Regulatory easing keeps widening the high-net-worth product menu
items.summary_zh: 依金管會高資產客戶管理辦法，銀行對資產達 1 億元以上客戶可提供更多元、更複雜的金融商品與諮詢服務，且獲准辦理的銀行名單持續擴增。此制度為刻意鬆綁，旨在留住高資產族群資金於境內、支持台灣打造亞洲資產管理中心，讓合格銀行得對富裕客戶銷售結構型商品、海外債等複雜工具，並加劇私人銀行業務在傳承規劃與跨境理財的競爭。財管手續費收入可望成為銀行獲利成長引擎，惟商品適配與投資人保護仍為監理重點。
items.summary_en: Under the FSC's high-net-worth customer rules, banks serving clients with at least NT$100mn in assets can offer a broader, more sophisticated product and advisory line-up, and the roster of approved institutions continues to expand. The regime — a deliberate loosening designed to keep wealthy Taiwanese assets onshore and support the island's asset-management-centre push — lets qualified banks distribute structured products, offshore bonds and other complex instruments to affluent clients, intensifying competition among private-banking arms for succession and cross-border mandates.

items.title_zh: 財政部釐清預售屋房地合一稅適用範圍
items.title_en: MOF clarifies capital-gains tax scope for pre-sale housing contracts
items.summary_zh: 財政部週五發布函釋，說明房地合一稅對預售屋的適用認定。凡 105 年（2016）1 月 1 日以前簽約購入預售屋，但於 105 年 1 月 1 日以後才登記取得房地所有權、之後再出售者，屬房地合一稅課稅範圍。財政部並提醒，換屋族申請自住房地重購優惠時，預售屋「簽約日」並非房地取得日，此一認定攸關適用資格與持有期間計算，購屋族進出預售市場前宜先確認稅務效果，避免誤判稅負或喪失優惠。
items.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance issued guidance on Friday clarifying how the consolidated housing-and-land capital-gains tax applies to pre-sale ("off-plan") homes. Where a pre-sale unit was contracted before 1 January 2016 but the property title was registered after that date and later sold, the transaction falls within the tax's scope. The MOF also reminded owner-occupiers seeking the repurchase preference that a pre-sale contract's signing date is not the property's acquisition date, a distinction that affects eligibility and holding-period calculations.

items.title_zh: 2026 遺產稅級距因 CPI 上漲 12.42% 上調，免稅額維持
items.title_en: 2026 estate-tax brackets rise on 12.42% CPI trigger; allowances unchanged
items.summary_zh: 2026 年台灣遺產稅免稅額與各項扣除額維持不變、未隨物價調整；但因累計 CPI 上漲 12.42%、達法定調整門檻，各級距金額同步提高，使高資產遺產的實質稅負相對減輕。贈與稅方面，年度免稅額維持 244 萬元，課稅級距亦隨之調整。稅務顧問指出，級距調整凸顯及早進行結構化財富傳承規劃的重要性，高資產家族可善用免稅額、信託與保單等工具，分年配置以優化整體稅務效果。
items.summary_en: For 2026, Taiwan's estate-tax exemption and various deductions are held flat, unadjusted for inflation. However, because cumulative CPI rose 12.42% and crossed the statutory adjustment threshold, the estate-tax bracket thresholds move higher — modestly easing the effective burden on high-net-worth estates. On the gift-tax side, the annual exemption stays at NT$2.44mn while bracket thresholds are likewise adjusted. Advisers say the changes reinforce the value of early, structured succession planning for wealthy families.

items.title_zh: 台灣 2026 成長預測分歧：主計總處 9.64%、中經院 7.22%
items.title_en: Forecasters split on Taiwan's 2026 growth: DGBAS 9.64% vs CIER 7.22%
items.summary_zh: 台灣總經展望維持強勁，但各機構預估分歧。主計總處預估 2026 年 GDP 成長率 9.64%、通膨率 1.93%；中華經濟研究院則估全年 7.22%，並形容為「前高後穩」，上半年成長約 10.69%、下半年放緩至約 4.10%。兩者均以 AI 帶動的出口與屢創新高的資本支出為主要動能，惟基期墊高將使年底前成長步調趨緩。強勁內外需仍支撐景氣，惟須留意全球 AI 需求與匯率波動對下半年動能的影響。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's macro outlook remains exceptionally strong but forecasts diverge. The government's DGBAS projects 2026 GDP growth of 9.64% and inflation of 1.93%, while the Chung-Hua Institution for Economic Research (CIER) pencils in 7.22%, describing a "high-then-steady" path with first-half growth near 10.69% cooling to about 4.10% in the second half. Both cite AI-driven exports and record capital spending as the engine, even as base effects moderate the pace into year-end.

items.title_zh: 聯準會維持利率 3.50%–3.75%，數據導向靜待關鍵報告
items.title_en: Fed holds at 3.50%–3.75%, stays data-dependent as key prints loom
items.summary_zh: 美國聯準會 7 月底會議維持政策利率於 3.50%–3.75%，未提供新的經濟預測，並重申後續動作取決於進場數據。市場焦點轉向密集的數據行事曆——8 月 7 日的 7 月非農就業報告與 8 月 12 日的 7 月 CPI，藉以研判央行傾向降息或延續按兵不動。核心 PCE 相對於聯準會 2% 目標的走勢，仍是牽動全球利率預期的關鍵訊號，並將透過美債殖利率與美元走勢間接影響台灣資金與匯市。
items.summary_en: The US Federal Reserve kept its policy rate at 3.50%–3.75% at its late-July meeting, offering no fresh projections and reiterating that further moves hinge on incoming data. Markets now pivot to a dense data calendar — the July employment report on 7 August and July CPI on 12 August — to gauge whether the central bank leans toward cuts or an extended hold. The path of core PCE, still measured against the Fed's 2% target, remains the pivotal signal for global rate expectations.

items.title_zh: 微軟財報引爆全球科技反彈，帶動台積電 ADR
items.title_en: Microsoft earnings ignite a global tech rebound, lifting TSMC's ADR
items.summary_zh: 台灣媒體點出週五台股創紀錄飆漲的華爾街催化劑：微軟繳出亮眼財報、Azure 雲端業務成長強勁，帶動前一美股交易日科技與半導體全面反攻。費城半導體指數勁揚約 8%，台積電 ADR 跳漲逾 7%，為台股晶片權值股的漲停行情鋪路。本地策略師認為，此波走勢是市場情緒在本週稍早劇烈評價重設後，重新轉向 AI 贏家族群，資金回流態勢明確，惟仍須留意漲多後的短線震盪與獲利了結賣壓。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese media flagged the Wall Street catalyst behind Friday's record TAIEX surge: a blockbuster Microsoft earnings report, powered by Azure cloud growth, sparked a broad technology and semiconductor rally in the prior US session. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index leapt about 8% and TSMC's ADR jumped more than 7%, setting the stage for limit-up moves in Taiwan's chip leaders. Local strategists framed the move as sentiment snapping back toward AI winners after a jarring mid-week valuation reset.

items.title_zh: 國際股市震盪封關月線收高，殖利率走升成隱憂
items.title_en: Overseas markets cap a volatile July higher despite surging yields
items.summary_zh: 台灣早報彙整了轉強的國際背景：美股在科技巨頭亮眼財報帶動下，以偏強姿態結束震盪的 7 月，儘管長天期美債殖利率攀升至多年新高。報導同時凸顯油價急漲與中東地緣風險猶存，這些因素將直接牽動台灣的輸入性通膨與出口成本展望。進入新的交易月，國際利率與原物料走勢，仍是評估台股與新台幣後市的重要外部變數，投資人宜密切追蹤。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese morning digests summarised a firmer international backdrop heading into August: US equities closed out a turbulent July on the front foot, buoyed by strong Big Tech earnings even as long-dated Treasury yields climbed to multi-year highs. Coverage also highlighted a sharp run-up in oil and lingering geopolitical risk around the Middle East, factors that feed directly into Taiwan's imported-inflation and export-cost outlook as the new trading month begins.
items.source_name: 蕃新聞 早安產經早報

items.title_zh: 美股震盪 7 月收高，Amazon 大漲 15%（2026-07-31）
items.title_en: US stocks close a volatile July higher as Amazon jumps 15% (2026-07-31)
items.summary_zh: 華爾街週五強勢收月，那斯達克指數漲約 1%、收 25,373.85 點，標普 500 漲 0.7%、收 7,489.72 點，道瓊漲 276.97 點、漲幅 0.53%、收 52,485.03 點。Amazon 財報優於預期、晶片業務擴張，股價飆漲約 15%，抵銷利率走升的疑慮。此波漲勢為震盪的 7 月畫下強勢句點，全月股市因科技巨頭財報而劇烈波動。
items.summary_en: Wall Street ended July on a strong note Friday, with the Nasdaq Composite up about 1% to 25,373.85, the S&P 500 up 0.7% to 7,489.72 and the Dow gaining 276.97 points, or 0.53%, to 52,485.03. Amazon shares soared roughly 15% after earnings beat expectations and its chip business expanded, offsetting jitters over rising rates. The advance capped a turbulent month for equities marked by sharp swings around Big Tech results.

items.title_zh: 油價飆漲、布蘭特突破 88 美元，美伊緊張與荷莫茲海峽干擾（2026-07-31）
items.title_en: Oil jumps as Brent tops $88 on US–Iran tensions and Hormuz disruption (2026-07-31)
items.summary_zh: 原油週五急漲，布蘭特原油突破每桶 88 美元，西德州中級原油單日上漲近 4%，延續單月逾 20% 的漲勢。此波漲勢主因美伊衝突再起，以及傳出部分油輪在全球原油運輸咽喉荷莫茲海峽被迫折返。油價急升重新點燃能源帶動通膨的疑慮，正值各國央行研判下一步政策之際，後續地緣情勢與供給風險為市場關注焦點。
items.summary_en: Crude prices surged Friday, with Brent climbing above $88 a barrel and West Texas Intermediate rising nearly 4% on the day, extending a monthly advance of more than 20%. The rally was driven by renewed hostilities between the US and Iran and reports that some tankers were forced to turn back at the Strait of Hormuz, a chokepoint for global crude flows. The move revived worries about energy-driven inflation just as central banks weigh their next steps.

items.title_en: Microsoft surges 15.5% on blockbuster earnings; chip index jumps 8.2% (2026-07-31)
items.summary_zh: 微軟繳出由 Azure 雲端成長領軍的亮眼季報後，股價飆漲約 15.5%，市值增加約 4,500 億美元，帶動科技股全面走高。費城半導體指數勁揚 8.2%，美光、超微、英特爾與 SK 海力士 ADR 同步繳出雙位數漲幅，資金重新湧入晶片股。此財報扭轉半導體類股近期弱勢，為全球半導體反彈定調，並成為亞股尤其台股次日強彈的關鍵催化劑。
items.summary_en: Microsoft shares rocketed about 15.5% after a blockbuster quarterly report led by Azure cloud growth, adding roughly $450bn in market value and powering a broad technology advance. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index climbed 8.2%, with Micron, AMD, Intel and SK Hynix's ADR posting double-digit gains as investors rushed back into chips. The results reversed recent weakness in the sector and set the tone for a global semiconductor rebound.

items.title_en: 30-year Treasury yield spikes to highest since 2007 near 5.25% (2026-07-31)
items.summary_zh: 儘管股市走高，美國長天期公債週五遭大幅拋售，30 年期公債殖利率單日上升約 4 個基點至約 5.25%，創 2007 年來最高。殖利率攀升反映市場對政府大量發債與通膨預期僵固的疑慮。股市勁揚與長天期殖利率同步走升的背離，凸顯市場一面押注經濟成長韌性，一面要求持有長券的更高風險補償，後續發債供給與通膨數據將是殖利率走向的關鍵。
items.summary_en: Even as stocks rallied, the long end of the US bond market sold off sharply Friday, pushing the 30-year Treasury yield up about 4 basis points to roughly 5.25% — its highest level since 2007. The climb reflected concerns over heavy government issuance and sticky inflation expectations. The divergence between surging equities and rising long-term yields underscored a market betting on resilient growth while demanding more compensation for holding long-dated debt.
